text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daitaku Helios ran an absolute peak
race!! 
The entire venue is going crazy!!
However, 
her crush Daiichi Ruby is—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her spirits remained low. K.S.Miracle's 
words echoed inside her: "Miracles will 
never happen again."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby might retire...? The mere 
thought leaves Daitaku Helios
heartbroken. 
Like, she hasn't even seen her genuine 
smile yet...!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Daitaku Helios can't even manage a 
whimper. Seeing her like this... Mejiro 
Palmer vows to be the bestie who lights
up 
her world."
